name: Personalized Wooden Ring Binder Cover
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and metal binder hardware, offering a sturdy, reusable, and elegant cover for recipes, notes, journals, and keepsake pages.
    - Made from 3mm thick wood, giving the binder cover a durable structure while keeping it lightweight enough for everyday use.
    - Features a strong metal ring binder mechanism with good elasticity for smooth opening and closing.
    - Designed with a personalized wooden cover in a warm natural finish, suitable for both decorative and practical use.
    - The wooden surface adds a rustic, handcrafted charm while helping protect the pages inside.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available cover sizes:
               +) For A5 paper size:
                       -> Cover size: 7.35 x 9.05 in ~ 18.67 x 23 cm
                       -> Thickness: 3.2 cm ~ 1.26 in
               +) For A4 paper size:
                       -> Cover size: 9.97 x 12.2 in ~ 25.3 x 31 cm
                       -> Thickness: 3.8 cm ~ 1.5 in
    - Metal Binder Size:
               +) For A4 paper size:
                       -> Length: 27.94 cm ~ 11 in
                       -> Top width: 2 cm ~ 0.79 in
                       -> Upper ring section: 3 cm ~ 1.18 in
                       -> Middle section: 11 cm ~ 4.33 in
               +) For A5 paper size:
                       -> Length: 20.7 cm ~ 8.15 in
                       -> Top width: 2 cm ~ 0.79 in
                       -> Ring section: 7 cm ~ 2.76 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses high-quality UV printing for clear details, vivid colors, and a long-lasting decorative finish.
    - The wooden cover is designed with 2-sided printing, allowing both outer and visible cover areas to have a polished finished look.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a ring binder cover and a personalized decorative keepsake.
    - Suitable for recipe books, planners, journals, family books, wedding guest materials, memory books, and note collections.
    - Great for organizing loose sheets while keeping them protected in a stylish cover.
    - Ideal for kitchens, offices, study desks, home organization, and gift collections.
    - Designed for repeated daily use while maintaining a neat and elegant appearance.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for moms, grandmas, wives, couples, friends, teachers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, housewarmings, Mother’s Day, recipe keepsakes, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who loves cooking, journaling, planning, or custom stationery.
    - Great as a family recipe binder, memory book cover, wedding keepsake, or personalized notebook cover.
    - A meaningful gift that combines function, organization, and sentimental charm 🎁

 

  • Easy to Use:
    - Open the metal ring binder.
    - Insert the punched paper pages.
    - Close the binder rings securely.
    - Use the wooden binder cover as a reusable personalized book cover for recipes, notes, or keepsakes.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Personalized Wooden Ring Binder Cover

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
